mechanism_claims.claim_text: P1 damages S. aureus/MRSA cell envelopes under direct imaging conditions; the paper reports SEM membrane damage after 1× MIC treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Directly supports membrane damage morphology for P1; does not by itself prove a single molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: P1 increases membrane permeability in S. aureus TISTR 517 and MRSA isolate 2468 in the SYTOX Green assay.
